questions.q: Q1. What does Tragram actually do?
questions.a: Tragram connects selected Telegram channels to your MT4/MT5 workflow. It helps you review, filter, and execute signals based on the rules you set.

questions.q: Q2. Do I have to auto-execute every signal?
questions.a: No. Eligible entries must pass the configured rules and target the selected execution account. Disabling new entries does not close existing broker positions.

questions.q: Q3. Can I limit what a channel is allowed to trade?
questions.a: Yes. You can set symbol filters, trade limits, sizing rules, and other channel-specific controls before trades go to your MT account.

questions.q: Q4. What happens if I want to stop a channel quickly?
questions.a: You can disable or pause the channel from the dashboard and prevent new trades from being opened while you review the setup.

questions.q: Q5. Does Tragram provide signals or trading advice?
questions.a: No. Tragram is a user-controlled execution and automation assistant. It does not sell signals or provide financial advice.

questions.q: Q6. Does it work with both MT4 and MT5?
questions.a: Yes. Tragram supports MT4 and MT5 accounts, with the exact workflow depending on your connected account and plan.
